text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhhh~! Buena-chan's running was so 
incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
I totally get it~~! Down that final 
stretch, you can intensely feel them 
giving it their absolute all...!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
She looks so petite and cute, but she's a 
true athlete... So cool...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: *pant*... Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone's faces are beaming. I wonder if 
I made them happy――)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: —So, what will they show us next?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
We already know how strong she is on the 
Tiara route! Next, I wanna see her mix it 
up with all the super strong girls from 
different generations even more!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That's true! I want Buena Vista to show 
everyone that she's the face of this era! 
Like at the Takarazuka Kinen, or in a 
Grand Prix race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
That's definitely gonna be an even more 
amazing race than today's, right? I can't 
wait~~!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(I see, the next race...! They're letting 
themselves dream even bigger...!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (...Yeah. I'm happy.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone is expecting even more from me! 
I'll do my best next time, too—)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —I wonder if that is truly alright...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Desire-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I received an ominous revelation. That up 
ahead... you might end up wandering into a 
deep forest.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"You have turned expectations into 
power... There is no doubt about that 
radiance."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However... the trees of a deep forest let 
no light through. A bottomless darkness... 
will engulf even the strongest of hearts.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. You're just worried about 
me, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
But you know, it's alright. To me, the 
applause is... the strongest wind of all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The bigger they grow, the further forward 
I can go. Because they're such precious 
voices to me!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, you're right. I thought it would 
be presumptuous of me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"You are like a saint to this world. You 
can shine a light on any shadow."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... the fact that you called out 
to me just shows how kind you are."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Desire-chan. From here on out, I want to 
live up to even more of everyone's 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Could you perhaps... let your feelings 
ride along with them?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You've always seen me as an important 
trial to overcome... and I want to keep 
answering those feelings of yours.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I'll keep being someone worthy of being 
your rival. So... will you keep expecting 
great things from me?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
And someday, take me to your world too, 
Desire-chan!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Buena-san...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. May the Saint's blessing be 
upon your path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista's expression was bright after 
the race, already full of drive for what 
lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: And so, about the next race...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I want to live up to everyone's 
expectations even more. That's why, what 
everyone wants from me—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I want to take on the other Grand Prix 
race— the Takarazuka Kinen!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Like the Arima Kinen, the Takarazuka Kinen 
is a Grand Prix race fueled by the dreams 
of fans. Indeed, a victory in this race 
would—
choice_data_list:
It's clear and lives up to expectations, 
huh.

It's clear and lives up to expectations, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Right? Then it's settled!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next target race was decided: 
the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Right then! I wonder if the 
interviewers will be arriving soon."
choice_data_list:
...Let's head home today without doing any 
press interviews.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh? But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might just be my imagination, but Buena 
Vista seemed more exhausted than usual. I 
wanted her to rest as soon as possible.
choice_data_list:
Leave the rest to this super popular 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah. ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Tell me what you talked about 
later, okay?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(...I said that, but... somehow, I can't 
settle down.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I'll do some race research. 
Somewhere quiet would be...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, looks like nobody's around here?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You again?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama-san...? Oh, do you have business 
at the Ritto dorms?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...This is the Miho dorm.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Having this poor a sense of direction is 
practically a talent in itself...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Whatever. The upcoming Takarazuka 
Kinen... You're running in it too, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A Grand Prix race is something the 
"Heroine of the Era" absolutely has to run 
in.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Um, when you say 'you too'...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I'm already looking forward to 
it—overturning an atmosphere completely 
dominated by Buena Vista.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll keep quiet about this. Now run 
along home, little lady."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes! —See you at Hanshin Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(...Haa. Going to the wrong dorm... I'm 
way too scatterbrained~)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Let's keep this a secret from 
Trainer...
